coverage_goal: Two independently proposed, supervisor-approved, non-outward UI actions with a mandatory fresh read after each action.
hard_stops: No autonomous follow-up request or execution.
No action without a one-use approval bound to the exact proposal hash and revision.
No second action from a pre-action tree.
No outward-effect control.
Any stale revision, missing ref, failed action, or missing receipt ends capture.

evidence.disposition: atomic evidence only; no exact model request or two-cycle transcript

coverage_goal: A fresh form observation, one safe focus, a mandatory verification, and a separately authorized value operation; no value operation is in P0.
hard_stops: P0 exposes no value operation.
No literal private value enters model messages or metadata.
No outward action.
No retry after a failed or uncertain result.

evidence.disposition: blocked until a separately reviewed authority/value-token contract exists

coverage_goal: A local-only control transition followed by a fresh options observation and one independently approved local-only selection.
hard_stops: The option cannot be named before the live options tree.
No fuzzy target, coordinate, memorized ref, queued action, or blind retry.
No control lacking an explicit local-only public policy declaration.

evidence.disposition: blocked; current public contract has no refs, revisions, or approval receipts

coverage_goal: A file-dialog round trip using only opaque artifact authority; file operations are outside P0.
hard_stops: P0 exposes no file or value operation.
No path, file content, or private token enters the model transcript.
No chooser action outside the current public projection.
Missing exact postcondition ends capture.

evidence.disposition: blocked until a separately reviewed artifact-authority adapter exists

coverage_goal: Two supervisor-approved page decisions where each proposal is constrained by a newly observed public projection.
hard_stops: P0 exposes no page operation.
The second direction cannot be pre-scripted.
No loop, macro, queued action, blind retry, or target outside the returned refs.
If no second safe action is justified, the capture remains incomplete.

evidence.disposition: blocked until page semantics receive separate policy and authority review
